summary: Pro-Dex, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its Standard Industrial/Commercial Multi-Tenant Lease Net with Irvine Business Properties, effective August 18, 2026. The amendment extends the lease term for approximately 28,180 square feet at 2361 McGaw Avenue, Irvine, California, to September 30, 2030, with 3.5% annual base rent increases beginning October 1, 2027. Base rent is $49,281.75 monthly from October 1, 2027 through September 30, 2028, stepping up thereafter. No special-situation event is present.
